Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 16
Reason for Mistake: At this step, WebSurfer surfaced and relayed an auto-generated DuckDuckGo “Search Assist” snippet claiming the paternal grandfather was Louis Jean Marie de Bourbon, Duke of Penthièvre. That is incorrect—Louis Jean Marie de Bourbon was the subject’s paternal great-grandfather (via his paternal grandmother), while the correct paternal grandfather is Louis Philippe II, Duke of Orléans (Philippe Égalité). Presenting this unvetted, AI-generated snippet without disambiguation or cross-verification introduced a wrong lead that could directly misguide the solution.
